main.description: Get a subject's community moderation state and its version, as indexed by this AppView. Requires authentication; the caller must be an owner or moderator of the subject's community, or an instance admin, and the community must be hosted by this instance and not removed. A post or comment subject is read in the community its index names, never the request community. The version starts at 0 and advances on every indexed community record change for the subject (acceptance, removal, ban and role records and their deletes). A post's status can also move through AppView-local states (pending, pending_reacceptance, rejected), and a ban stops being in force at its expiresAt; neither changes the version.

parameters.description: Subject whose community moderation state is requested

subject.description: A post or comment AT-URI, or a DID: an account's DID for its community ban, or the community's own DID for its roster

community.description: DID of the community; required when the subject is a DID, ignored for a post or comment AT-URI

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; sign in before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a moderator of the subject's community, or the community is not hosted here or is removed; do not retry unless that changes.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A DID subject was given without a valid community DID; correct the request before retrying.

errors.name: InvalidSubject
errors.description: The subject is malformed, uses an unsupported collection, or is a post or comment this AppView has not indexed in a community.

errors.name: ModerationUnavailable
errors.description: The moderation service is temporarily unavailable; retry later.

output.description: A subject's community moderation state and version; exactly the object for its kind is present, except that an account without an in-force ban has no ban

community.description: DID of the community whose state this is

version.description: Number of indexed community record changes for the subject (acceptance, removal, ban and role records and their deletes); 0 when there have been none. AppView-local post statuses and a ban reaching its expiresAt do not change it

postState.description: A post's admission in the community

status.description: Admission status of the post in the community; none when the community has no admission for it

removed.description: Whether the community has removed the comment

reason.description: Reason given in the ban record

expiresAt.description: When the ban ends; absent for a ban without an end

recordUri.description: AT-URI of the community's ban record
